title: Brazilian company registry, sanctions certificates, CGU bulk sanctions and name-frequency vocabulary (P236 cnpj_lookup, P239 tcu_certidoes, P240 cgu_sanctions_bulk, P252 ibge_name_frequency)
notes: Core names reused where they fit: legal_name, trade_name, status, cnae, partners, address, capital, opened, sanctioned (attributes); sanctions, pep, privacy, context_only, third_party (tags); located_at (relation). Personal data rules: QSA CPFs only as masked by the RFB, never pivots; registry contacts are never same-owner evidence.

attributes.status_date: ISO date of the current RFB registration status (data_situacao_cadastral; a status date, not data freshness)
attributes.status_reason: reason the RFB gives for the registration status (motivo da situacao cadastral)
attributes.special_status: RFB special situation {status, date} when present (situacao especial)
attributes.branch_type: MATRIZ (head office) or FILIAL (branch) of a CNPJ
attributes.cnaes_secondary: secondary economic activities [{code, label}] (7-digit CNAE codes; labels as given by the provider until the CNAE tables land)
attributes.legal_nature: legal nature {code, label} of a company (RFB natureza juridica)
attributes.company_size: company size class (RFB porte: MICRO EMPRESA, EMPRESA DE PEQUENO PORTE, DEMAIS)
attributes.individual_entrepreneur: bool: MEI or empresario individual registration - its name, contacts and address are personal data
attributes.address_details: registered address parts {street_type, street, number, complement, district, city, uf, cep, ibge_code}
attributes.rfb_emails: e-mail addresses registered at the RFB for a CNPJ (registry contacts, often the accounting firm; never same-owner evidence)
attributes.rfb_phones: phones registered at the RFB for a CNPJ (E.164; registry contacts, often the accounting firm; never same-owner evidence)
attributes.qsa: QSA table as published by the RFB [{name, kind, doc_as_given (RFB-masked CPF or partner CNPJ), role, since, age_band, country, legal_rep}]; shown only in the CNPJ card
attributes.qsa_former: partners of earlier RFB dumps still listed by a provider (history only, never pivots)
attributes.state_registrations: state tax registrations (inscricoes estaduais) [{ie, uf, active, updated}]
attributes.federative_entity: responsible federative entity (ente federativo responsavel) of a public-law entity
attributes.company_age_years: company age in years from its opening date (an attribute for correlation packs, never a finding by itself)
attributes.cnpj_card: CNPJ card header {provider, data_date, status, status_plain, opening_date, age_years}
attributes.rfb_snapshot: RFB open-data dump month an answer comes from (YYYY-MM)
attributes.field_sources: per-field provenance of a merged record {field: {provider, as_of}}
attributes.field_conflicts: fields on which providers disagree [{field, chosen {provider, value, as_of}, alternatives [{provider, value, as_of}]}] (the freshest wins)
attributes.provider_chain: per-provider outcome of a fallback chain [{provider, source, state, reason}]
attributes.providers_pending_review: providers coded behind a module's normaliser but never called until legal records their terms [{provider, host, reason}]
attributes.certificate_lists: per-list state of a consolidated sanctions certificate {list: {state: consta | nada_consta | unknown, text, issued_at, emitter, link}}
attributes.certificate_issued_at: issue time of a consolidated sanctions certificate (TCU dataHoraEmissao, ISO 8601)
attributes.tcu_base_found: bool: the CNPJ exists in the TCU base (seCnpjEncontradoNaBaseTcu); false means the certificate is not evidence of a clean record
attributes.sanctions_screening: per-list state of an offline sanctions screening {list: {state: no_record | listed | not_screened, file_date, reason}}
attributes.first_name_frequency: IBGE Census count of people with this first name {first_name, frequency, source} (aggregate statistics; nothing is inferred about the person)
attributes.homonym_risk: homonym risk of a name for name-only matches {risk: high | medium | low | unknown, factor, phrase, first_name_tier, common_surname}

tags.company_status: company registration not active at the RFB (BAIXADA, INAPTA, SUSPENSA, NULA)
tags.shared_contact: registry contact shared by more than 20 CNPJs (possible accountant or virtual office): never same-owner evidence
tags.name_only_match: match on a name alone, without any identifier: 'possible match', lowered by the homonym score (P252)

relations.partner_of: cnpj -> QSA partner listed by the RFB (person name or company): the pivot is a partner or officer of the company; person names are name-only (identity not established)
relations.rfb_contact: cnpj -> e-mail or phone registered at the RFB (registry contact, often the accounting firm): never same-owner evidence
relations.rfb_contact_domain: cnpj -> domain of an RFB registry contact e-mail (third party unless registro.br RDAP ties it to the same CNPJ root)
relations.legal_name: cnpj -> registered legal name (razao social); never triggers a name-to-CNPJ resolver
